adjudication_findings.claim: Optimal exponent four, not an exact fourth-power family; k>2/(4-alpha); k=3 refutes cubic, k=2 does not.
adjudication_findings.reason: 2-1/k>alpha/2 is equivalent to k>2/(4-alpha). See T-K3.

I read all 118 rows against the paper. The two corrections stand. Blanket 'correct' does not survive for rows whose defect is dependency or target text: see ledger_row_changes (def-log-convention, cor-cubic-refuted, claim-minimax-mu and others).

adjudication_findings.claim: D=O(Q^4) and the cubic conjecture originate in the 2020 four-author preprint, not only the five-author paper.
adjudication_findings.reason: Existence and authorship verified from ABKRT. Contents (Theorem 1 p.2, Conjecture 4 p.9 as r2 reports) are not held locally, so unverified here. ABKRT Conjecture 2 p.20 and Theorems 1-3 verified in the held PDF.

adjudication_findings.claim: cor-cubic-refuted depends on claim-exponent-ratio and eq-2, not thm-1.1.
adjudication_findings.reason: Accepted; eq-2 is redundant given claim-exponent-ratio. See M-4.
m^(5/3)/log^2 m against (sqrt m polylog)^3=m^(3/2)polylog: ratio m^(1/6)/polylog tends to infinity. k=2 gives m^(3/2)/log^2 m and does not refute.
If R<=C Q^3 then R<=C(1+Q)^3, contradicting claim-exponent-ratio at alpha=3, k=3. The ledger's note and 'equivalently' clause add a nonconstancy lemma for nothing.

ledger_history.earlier_ledger_wording: It is false that R(f) = O(Q(f)^3) for all total Boolean f ([3, Conjecture 2]). Equivalently no C satisfies R(f) <= C Q(f)^3 for all total f with Q(f)>=1.

presentation.body: The assertion $R(f)=O(Q(f)^3)$ for all total Boolean functions $f$ is false, refuting Conjecture 2 of reference [3]: no constant $C$ satisfies $R(f)\le C Q(f)^3$ for every total $f$.
presentation.body_plain: The assertion R(f) = O(Q(f)³) for all total Boolean functions f is false, refuting Conjecture 2 of reference [3]: no constant C satisfies R(f) ≤ C Q(f)³ for every total f.
presentation.title: Refuting the universal cubic conjecture

statement: It is false that R(f) = O(Q(f)^3) for all total Boolean f ([3, Conjecture 2]): no C satisfies R(f) <= C Q(f)^3 for all total f.
